title: Hellper 2: Killberos
synopsis: Jang Dae-Ho, the infamous vice president of the Nine Snake Family gang overthrown after 'the purge', was disposing of dead assassins bodies in the ruins of the grand earthquake that struck the forsaken city of Kana when he found a starved and nameless orphan. Taking him under his wing and giving him the name "Gwangnam" would be the catalyst for a long and bloody revenge journey under which the name "Killberos" began. Thus, this is the dark story of Gwangnam's crime infested upbringing, riddled with the many street rivalries and gangs' power struggles that preceded the formation of the fence project and "Killberos", the guard tribe, as we know it before his passing.

synopsis: Mizuno, your average high-school guy, finds himself sitting next to the mysterious Wakao after a seat change. While everyone else in class sees her as a perfectly beautiful, ordinary girl... To Mizuno alone, she appears as a Noppera-bo, the faceless yokai of Japanese folklore! Yet... every so often, he’s actually able to catch rare, fleeting glimpses of her features. In this romantic, often comedic coming-of-age tale, we follow this endearing couple as they navigate through the tribulations of high-school and first love! (Source: Manga UP!)

synonyms: Gloomy Neighbor at the Standing Bar
synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. But one day, after coming to the rescue of a college girl who was getting unwelcome attention at the bar, he finds himself sitting next to her every week. From small-talk about daily life to lighthearted complaints… Even though it's just casual conversation, it's so nice to have someone beside you, having a laugh together — it's a romantic comedy that makes you look forward to those Friday nights at the bar, where you feel free to get a little tipsy. (Source: Manga UP!, translated)
